changelogs: - Fixed MSK.Call on Linux servers. Internally the core asked its module loader for 'timeout' while the folder is modules/Timeout. Windows ignores case, so this only ever showed up on Linux, where the load returned nothing and every MSK.Call aborted
- Scripts that reach MSK.Call through the module were never affected, only the core-internal path

- The error message behind that lookup no longer claims the module is 'not yet ported'. Timeout has shipped since v3.0.0, so the old wording sent people looking for a missing feature instead of a failed load

- The eager-loading example in import.lua and the module examples in init/shared.lua used lowercase names that match no folder. They now show the real spelling and state that the name is case-sensitive on Linux
- Replace fxmanifest.lua, init/shared.lua and import.lua to update

- Added MSK.AddRawAce and MSK.RemoveRawAce for ace objects that must not live under command. MSK.AddAce always prefixes with command., and since almost every server.cfg has 'add_ace group.admin command allow' and aces are inherited by their children, a permission object named command.something would be handed to everyone holding command. The raw variants pass principal and ace through exactly as given, so qbcore.admin stays qbcore.admin

- Called from a script, MSK.AddRawAce runs through msk_core's export, so add_ace is executed as resource.msk_core. FiveM checks that command against the resource running it, and import.lua compiles the modules into the consumer, so a script could never do this on its own. One line in your server.cfg now covers every MSK script
- Added MSK.CanAddAce() so a script can check up front whether msk_core may run add_ace, instead of firing commands that get refused with 'Access denied for command add_ace'
- Added MSK.GetVehicleFromPlate(plate), finds a spawned vehicle by its plate without needing coords or a radius, client and server
- The search always runs on the server, the client asks over the callback API and gets the network id back, so no client walks its own vehicle pool
- Client side is a callback round trip and therefore blocking, call it from inside a thread
- A network id without a local handle means the vehicle exists but is not streamed in for that client
- Added MSK.GetModelFromPlate(plate), reads the model out of the framework vehicle table (ESX owned_vehicles, QBCore player_vehicles), also answers while the vehicle is parked in a garage
- Plates are now compared trimmed and upper cased on both sides of the comparison, inner spaces are kept on purpose
- Every NUI component now sits behind its own error boundary, one failing component no longer takes the whole interface down
- A failed NUI component reports to the client console with its name and comes back on the next NUI message
- Replace fxmanifest.lua, init/client.lua, the modules/Vehicle folder and web/dist to update

- Changed files [fxmanifest.lua, init/client.lua, modules/Vehicle/shared.lua, modules/Vehicle/client.lua, modules/Vehicle/server.lua, web/src/App.tsx, web/src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx, web/dist, Readme.md]
- Rebuilt the NUI on updated dependencies (React 19, Vite 8, TypeScript 7, FontAwesome 7)
- No API or behavior change, the Lua side is untouched
- FontAwesome 7 ships only woff2, the unused .ttf fonts were removed from web/dist
- Replace fxmanifest.lua and web/dist to update
- Changed both menus to a namespaced API: MSK.Context.Register/Show/Update/Hide/GetOpen and the same set on MSK.Menu
- The flat names from v3.1.0 (MSK.RegisterContext, MSK.ShowMenu, ...) keep working, nothing breaks
- Changed MSK.Menu.Close to MSK.Menu.Hide (Close stays as an alias) so it matches MSK.Context.Hide
- Fixed that the Menu module exposed its internal navigation functions on the public table
- Pure Lua change, the NUI is untouched, web/dist can stay as it is
- Added MSK.Context - mouse driven context menu with sub menus, icons, progress bars and metadata (clientside & serverside)
- Added MSK.Menu - keyboard navigated menu with side scroll values and checkboxes, player can keep walking and driving (clientside & serverside)
- Added MSK.UpdateContext and MSK.UpdateMenu to update a single option live while the menu is open
- Fixed that a nil text (e.g. a MSK.Notification call without a message) could crash the whole NUI
- The NUI was rebuilt, replace the whole web/dist folder
- For more details see the documentation and the Changelogs on Github
- Fixed QBCore item functions in MSK.GetPlayer (AddItem, RemoveItem, HasItem, GetItem)
- Fixed eager loading so every module is safe to load up front (no more duplicate notifications, callbacks, events, commands or crons)
- Fixed MSK.Cron table not being usable from other resources
- For more details see the documentation and the Changelogs on Github
- [Major release] Rewritten whole Script with new features and better performance
- For more details see the documentation and the Changelogs on Github
- Fixed that icons are not loading in the ui
- Added 'chat:removeSuggestion' for MSK.RegisterCommand if parameter showSuggestion is set to false
- Fixed error on playerConnected on function `GetPlayerDeath`
- Fixed error with core_inventory on function `HasItem`
- Some code improvements and removing of old exports
- Fixed error `Execution of function reference in script host failed` on script start
- Fixed error `attempt to call a table value (field 'Request')`
- Fixed a Bug with with Ace Perms in `MSK.RegisterCommand` -> serverside
- Changes on `MSK.Player` for better performance with `MSK.Player.coords`
- Changed `MSK.RegisterCommand` syntax but added backwards compatibility
- Changed Bansystem Commands to new syntax
- Changed ShowCoords Command to new syntax
- Fixed that 'MSK.Input()' and 'MSK.Numpad()' does not work on older scripts
- Added some new function and exports
